steps.en: PLUS can ask for a notice's current suspensions
steps.id: PLUS bisa meminta suspension notice yang sedang berjalan

steps.en: Suspension details are sent to PLUS
Reduction details are visible only as a suspension line
steps.id: Detail reduction hanya terlihat sebagai baris suspension
steps.why_en: PLUS does not get the reduction record or the amount before reduction.
steps.why_id: PLUS tidak menerima record reduction atau nilai sebelum reduction.

steps.en: The current notice status is available to PLUS
steps.id: Status notice terkini tersedia untuk PLUS

steps.en: Details follow a passed check only if PLUS asks
steps.id: Detail menyusul setelah cek lolos hanya jika PLUS memintanya
steps.why_en: OCMS does not push the details after validation; PLUS must call separate services.
steps.why_id: OCMS tidak mengirim detail setelah validasi; PLUS harus memanggil layanan terpisah.
